name: Mystic Jeweler
body:
Your skill at working with jewelry and mastery of the art of binding magic to the circular form allow you to create unique works of art.

Prerequisite(s): Forge Ring, Craft( jewelry) or Profession (jeweler) 10 ranks

Benefit(s): You can create magic rings as other forms of body jewelry. The ring created must still maintain a primarily circular shape, maintaining an effectively closed ring but may be worn in the ears or as a body piercing without taking up a body slot. Crafting a ring in this manner takes 50% longer than it would to craft the same ring traditionally and costs an additional 50% of the base cost.
